title: Bitwise Or Of Adjacent Elements
description:
Given an array nums of length n, return an array answer of length n - 1 such that answer[i] = nums[i] | nums[i + 1] where | is the bitwise OR operation.
 
Example 1:

Input: nums = [1,3,7,15]
Output: [3,7,15]

Example 2:

Input: nums = [8,4,2]
Output: [12,6]

Example 3:

Input: nums = [5,4,9,11]
Output: [5,13,11]

 
Constraints:

2 <= nums.length <= 100
0 <= nums[i] <= 100

def check(candidate):
    assert candidate([1, 3, 7, 15]) == [3, 7, 15]
    assert candidate([8, 4, 2]) == [12, 6]
    assert candidate([5, 4, 9, 11]) == [5, 13, 11]
    assert candidate([0, 0]) == [0]
    assert candidate([1, 2, 4, 8, 16]) == [3, 6, 12, 24]
    assert candidate([7, 7, 7]) == [7, 7]
    assert candidate([0, 1, 0, 1, 0]) == [1, 1, 1, 1]
    assert candidate([32, 1]) == [33]
